stories.title: Israeli strikes kill 11 in south Lebanon, health ministry says​
stories.summary: Israeli strikes kill 11 in south Lebanon, health ministry says​ We earlier reported Israeli attacks kill nine people in southern Lebanon. Lebanon's health ministry now reports that at least 11 people were killed in Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon on Saturday. Seven people were killed when Israeli warplanes struck a house in the southern village of Ansar, while four others were killed in a strike on the village of Deir El Zahrani, Lebanon's official National News Agency said. Nineteen people were wounded in the attacks. The strikes were among the deadliest in the weeks since Lebanon agreed to a US-mediated peace framework with Israel.
